display.title: Episode 8: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: A young guest explains Torah and mitzvos as the secret weapon against the yetzer hara, and in chapter 2 a mysterious rabbi and ten students arrive at the orphans' wedding with ten astonishing gifts.
display.summary_long: After a clap-along tune and a recap of chapter 1, a young Tzivos Hashem member returns to the studio. He explains that joining Hashem's army means fighting the yetzer hara, and Uncle Yossi agrees that the secret weapon is learning Torah and doing mitzvos; then the guest leads the Shema. In chapter 2 of "The Ten Wedding Gifts", Reuven tells Avraham and Sarah that freeing the captive was worth more than all the gold in the world, pays for their wedding clothes himself and invites the whole town. As the chuppah is about to begin under the open sky, a holy-looking rabbi with a red beard walks in with ten students. He agrees to say the brachos, and at last reveals that he is the Baal Shem Tov, sent by the Heavenly Court to bless them. Each student announces a gift, a park, a lumberyard and more, every one the property of a local poritz. The Baal Shem Tov blesses everyone and leaves in a coachman-less wagon that vanishes in a flash. How can these gifts come true? Chapter 3 will tell. The mailbox reads a listener's letter.
display.lesson: Hashem's watchful eye sees every good deed and rewards it in full measure.
